description.narrative: Oxfam in Cambodia works to promote inclusive and sustainable economic development by strengthening SMEs, social enterprises, and market systems that create positive social impact, particularly for women, youth, and marginalized communities. Through its enterprisedevelopment initiatives, Oxfam supports businesses to become more resilient, investment-ready, and environmentally sustainable, while also promoting inclusive business models that improve livelihoods and access to economic opportunities. One of Oxfam’s key initiatives is the Impact SMEs (I-SME) project, which supports high-potential SMEs through technical assistance, business development support, market linkage, and investment readiness. The project focuses on helping enterprises scale sustainably while strengthening their social and environmental impact. Oxfam also implements the Enterprise Development Programme (EDP), a global initiative that supports small and growing businesses through tailored grants, capacity strengthening, and access to Oxfam’s broader ecosystem of partners, mentors, and markets. Building on these experiences, Oxfam is well-positioned to support the implementation of the Equi Green Fund, particularly in the areas of pipeline development and Technical Assistance (TA) facility management. Through its long-standing work with SMEs, inclusive business, and impact enterprise ecosystems, Oxfam has developed strong capacities in identifying and strengthening investable enterprises, delivering tailored business support, and connecting enterprises with financing opportunities. Oxfam’spresence and operational experience across Cambodia, Timor-Leste, and Indonesia also provide a strong foundation for regional coordination and implementation of the fund across the three target countries. Leveraging Oxfam’s global network and partnerships, Oxfam in Cambodia also connects local enterprises to regional and international stakeholders, including investors, buyers, business support organizations, and development partners. The organization works across sectors such as agriculture, WASH, green enterprise, and circular economy to help enterprises access finance, strengthen business practices, and contribute to more inclusive and sustainable economic systems.

participating-org.narrative: Oxfam Novib is one of the 17 national affiliates of the Oxfam International Confederation. It started life in 1956 as the Netherlands Organisation for International Assistance (Novib), and joined forces with Oxfam in 1994. Working together in confederation, the Oxfam affiliates can speak with one clear and compelling voice on issues of global concern: climate change, health and education forall, agriculture, trade, and conflicts and emergencies. Oxfam established this country office to support local organizations and projects. Through this local office Oxfam Novib directly contributes towards this project#s implementation.
